description: Active SWPC alerts, watches, and warnings — parsed into structured records with product type, NOAA scale and level, issue time, serial number, validity window, and plain text. Covers geomagnetic storms, radio blackouts, and radiation storms. With active_only=false, also returns informational summaries, expired notices, and cancellations. max_age_hours controls how far back to look for candidates (default 48 h) — under active_only=true it does not cut off a product whose validity end is still in the future, and under active_only=false it is a literal age cutoff. The SWPC feed keeps all historical records and has no built-in expiry.

active_only.description: When true (default), return only in-force Warnings, Watches, and Alerts. Excluded: Summaries and unrecognized products; products whose validity end has passed; cancellation notices; any product a later cancellation names by serial; and all but the newest record carrying the "THIS SUPERSEDES ANY/ALL PRIOR WATCHES IN EFFECT" line. Counts per reason ride in the exclusions enrichment field. Set false to return every product in the window, cancellations included (flagged by the cancelled field).

max_age_hours.description: How far back to look for products, in hours (default 48). The SWPC feed retains all historical records, so this bounds the candidate set rather than declaring what is current. Under active_only=true a product whose validity end is still in the future is returned even when its issue time falls outside this window — a multi-day Watch would otherwise disappear while a day it forecasts a storm for is still running. Under active_only=false it is literal and cuts at exactly the requested age.

name: noaa_spaceweather_get_alerts

activeOnly.description: Echo of active_only: true for the in-force set, false for every product in the window.

cancelled.description: True when this record cancels an earlier product; the cancelled product itself stays false. Always false under active_only=true, which drops both.

level.description: NOAA scale level 0–5 stated in the body; 0 means no scale is stated, not zero severity.

messageCode.description: Full message code from the body, e.g. "WARK04".

noaaScale.description: NOAA scale stated in the body, e.g. "G1"; null when none.

phenomenon.description: Phenomenon from the scale letter, e.g. "Geomagnetic".

productType.description: Product type, from the code prefix.

serialNumber.description: SWPC serial number, e.g. "1125"; null when absent. Unique only within messageCode; the Cancel, Extension to, and Continuation of Serial Number lines in message point at it.

validFrom.description: ISO 8601 UTC validity start stated in the body; null when none.

validTo.description: ISO 8601 UTC validity end; for a Watch, the end of its last listed storm day. Null when nothing states or implies an end.

appliedCutoff.description: ISO 8601 UTC start of the applied window. Present only under active_only=true.

appliedWindowHours.description: max_age_hours as applied. Present only under active_only=true.

error.description: Present when the call failed. Absent on success.

code.description: JSON-RPC error code for this failure.

reason.description: Machine-readable failure mode. Declared by this tool: `feed_unavailable`: SWPC feed returns 5xx or 429, times out, or answers with a body that is not parseable JSON. Retried for up to 45 seconds in total before failing. `feed_moved`: SWPC feed path returns a permanent 4xx (404, 410, 401, 403). Fails in one attempt. Other values are possible when a failure originates below the handler.

recovery.description: Actionable next step for the caller.

message.description: Human-readable description of what went wrong.

exclusions.description: Records active_only=true left out, each counted under its first reason in field order; with totalCount they sum to the feed total. Present only under active_only=true, when something was excluded.

agedOut.description: Issued before the window, no validity end ahead.

superseded.description: Replaced by a newer superseding Watch.

notice.description: Set when no products were returned.
